stories.title: First Plaid-led Welsh Budget to shape Flintshire’s funding for 2027-28
stories.summary: Finance Minister Elin Jones publishes the first full budget of the new Plaid Cymru-led Welsh Government today, with Flintshire County Council still waiting to know how it will close a £27.8m gap for 2027-28.

stories.title: Welsh Government sets out plan to end corridor care in hospitals across Wales
stories.summary: Welsh Government has published a plan to end corridor care in Welsh hospitals, with up to £23.3 million for NHS Wales to deliver it. stories.title: Fifth generation joins Chester butcher’s shop as family business reaches 130 years
stories.summary: A Chester butcher’s shop that has been in the same family since 1896 now has a fifth generation behind the counter, as it prepares to mark 130 years in business. stories.title: Sir Tom Jones to headline Llangollen Pavilion in June 2027
stories.summary: Sir Tom Jones will play an outdoor headline show at Llangollen Pavilion on Monday 28 June next year. Tickets for the fully seated concert go on sale at 10:00 GMT on Friday 20 November through llangollen.net and Ticketmaster. The 86-year-old last played the venue in 2024, when the show sold out during the core week
